questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which of the following compound is not aromatic?
questions.solution:
Aromatic compounds satisfy $(4 n+2) \pi$ Huckel rule. (a) 1,3 -cyclobutene
Number of $\pi$ electrons $=4\because$ It is not equal to $4 n+2\therefore$ It is not an aromatic compound (b) Pyridine
Number of $\pi$ electrons $=6(=4 n+2)$ (Here lone pair of electrons of N does not evolve in delocalisation) (c) Furane
Number of $\pi$ electrons $=4+2=6(=4 n+2)$ (d) Thiophene
Number of $\pi$ electrons $=6(=4 n+2)$ Thus, except 1,3 -cyclobutene, all species are aromatic in nature.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Among the following four compounds
A. Phenol
B. Methyl phenol
C. meta-nitrophenol
D. para nitrophenol
the acidity order is
questions.solution:
An electron withdrawing group (-I showing group like $\left.-\mathrm{NO}_2,-\mathrm{CN}\right)$ stabilises the phenoxide ion, thus when present, increases the acidity of phenol. On the other hand electron releasing groups ($+I$ showing group like $-\mathrm{CH}_3,-\mathrm{C}_2 \mathrm{H}_5$), when present, decrease the acidity of phenol by destabilising phenoxide ion. Hence, the correct order of acidity of given compounds is
\(\underset{(D)}{\text{p-nitrophenol}} \gt  \underset{(C)}{\text{m-nitrophenol}} \gt  \underset{(A)}{\text{phenol}} \gt  \underset{(B)}{\text{methyl phenol}}\)
(due to intermolecular H -bonding)
